text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—*Sheathes sword.*
Thank you very much.
(Ooooohhh...!)
Those witnessing Durandal's sharpness for the first time stir in amazement. However...

The result wasn't bad.
However, to my eyes, her usual sharp edge
didn't seem quite as keen as always.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King.
For now, please accept the spoils of this battle.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The first battlefield I ever raced across...
There was a racing pulse in my chest, and a touch of bewilderment.
choice_data_list: Weren't able to give it your all?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I believe I gave it my all.
However――"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't quite get a feel for the ground.
It was as if my feet were floating a bit, so to speak...

Not only myself, but Durandal also
seemed to feel a slight sense of unease. However...
What could be the reason? Is the turf on the racetrack different from Tracen Academy's? Or perhaps...

"You don't get it~?
Ehehe, in that case..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Should Maya tell you?
Maya figured it out!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Mayano... Top Gun-san!?
Why is Mayano-san here...?

Before the race, a girl was staring
intently at Durandal. Yes, this Umamusume was—

—Mayano Top Gun. An airplane-loving prodigy
who can grasp anything in a single instant.

Her race record is magnificent as well,
with 4 GⅠ victories: the Kikuka Sho, Arima Kinen,
Takarazuka Kinen, and Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, you see~. Durandal-san probably...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The front part of your right leg!
It hasn't fully recovered yet, so I think you shouldn't push yourself!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The front of the right leg...?
So somewhere around the shin...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I did occasionally feel a hard jolt, now that you mention it... I didn't think it was anything serious, but...
choice_data_list: The shin, huh... So is it splints?
The shin, huh... Could it be splints?

text_block_list.text:
"—A splint. In other words, a kind of bone swelling.
If that's showing up..."

"Feeling something off at full gallop during a race
was only natural. It was obvious her sharpness would dull."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice. But Mayano-san,
even Trainer couldn't figure it out, so how did you...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, you see~ Maya was just the same!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
My legs weren't doing so great,
so I held back until the Kikuka Sho,
and after that, I had a blast running!

"Having gone through the same trouble herself,
she seemed to figure it out at a single glance."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, here's the other reason
Maya figured out~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm a mature lady♪
I can see right through everything!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see... A mature woman...
That's true, Mayano-san looks like a child, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
At times, she shows the wisdom of a sage.
One cannot take her prophecies lightly...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, it seems best that we heed their words for now
and confirm it for ourselves.

—A few days later. After a formal examination,
a mild splint was confirmed on Durandal's right leg.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Just as I feared...
I am terribly sorry... I, Durandal... feel thoroughly ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even after you went through the trouble of knighting me...
I had intended to charge to the top by the shortest route possible, yet...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, my King.
I don't even know how to properly apologize...
choice_data_list: No, I'm the one who should be apologizing...
No, I'm the one who should apologize...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Why do you apologize, my King?
You are far too kind. Please, raise your head.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You are not to blame.
It was all my...
choice_data_list: No, I should have noticed sooner.
No, I should have noticed it myself.

text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's intuition saved the day,
but detecting abnormalities is supposed to be the Trainer's job.
I'm still far from being a king worthy of Durandal. I have so much left to learn.
choice_data_list: Let's rest the "Holy Sword" for a while.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Rest him...? Does that mean we won't be setting a target race for now?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's strengthen our trust through the end of the year.
Yeah, let's strengthen our trust until the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Strengthening trust...
That means deepening the bond between master and servant, correct?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. It is due to my own inadequacy that
I must force you into a secluded life for a while, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I shall devote myself all the more to serve you.
I will never let you want for anything!"

This is not a battle to be rushed.
If rushing were to nick the blade of my precious "Holy Sword,"
it would be a disaster.

We decided to have her take it easy in races for a while,
waiting until she returned to top form.
